transportEnvelope.payload: The FastMCP tool result contains JSON text in its first text content item. Decode exactly one JSON object; reject missing, multiple-conflicting, non-text, non-object, or invalid-JSON payloads.

operations.availability: Registered only when Forge dynamic verification is enabled.

required.bundle_path: string local path; strip at client boundary
required.firmware_path: string local path; strip at client boundary

operations.errorResponse: A structured object containing pv_id, error, and verdicts:[] may be returned instead of throwing.
operations.normalization: Map camelCase input to the exact snake_case keys. Preserve verdict/enrichment data, but never expose bundle_path or firmware_path through ForgeComputeClient.

operations.availability: Registered only when Forge core/produce pen-test tooling is enabled.

required.firmware_path: string local rootfs path; same-host stdio only

operations.errorResponse: Preflight can synchronously return {success:false,error:string,environment:string,pending_switch?:object} and creates no job.
operations.normalization: Return only jobId after success. Convert preflight failure to RemoteError. Never expose evidence_root, registry, firmware_path, or other Forge-local paths. Remote HTTP/SSE is unsupported for this path until a secure root transfer/registration contract exists.

operations.availability: Always registered with Forge job monitoring.
operations.normalization: Split log_tail into bounded lines, strip log_path and local paths nested in known top-level envelopes, preserve bounded events/result, and map raw CANCELLED to normalized FAILED with code FORGE_JOB_CANCELLED.

operations.availability: Always registered with Forge job monitoring.
operations.errorResponse: No dedicated application error envelope is declared; transport/shape failures become RemoteError.
operations.normalization: Strip log_path and run_dir, normalize each item to ForgeJobSnapshot metadata, and yield one RemotePage with total=count and next=null.

required.snapshots: Async sequence of normalized get_job_status results

operations.errorResponse: Transport errors and malformed snapshots become RemoteError; abort stops polling.
operations.normalization: Stop on COMPLETED, FAILED, or TIMEOUT; raw CANCELLED first normalizes to FAILED/FORGE_JOB_CANCELLED.

unresolved.reason: Forge commit 5083a9d7 exposes no MCP tool that registers or prepares a firmware root. Same-host stdio may be implemented through plugin-owned environment-at-spawn and controlled process restart after WP-50 proves digest and lifecycle behavior. Remote HTTP/SSE must return unsupported until a separately reviewed method exists.

forbidden: No Platform or Assurance Studio tool may be added to this allowlist.
No generic MCP tool name or arbitrary arguments seam may be exposed.
No Forge-local path may cross the ForgeComputeClient boundary.
A method absent from this manifest is unavailable until provenance, source hashes, request/response mapping, and tests are reviewed.
